questions.text: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Over the past 2 weeks have you not been able to stop or control worrying
Little interest or pleasure in doing things

title: Patient Health Questionnaire-4 (PHQ-4)
about: Four questions about anxiety and depression in the past two weeks: the GAD-2 and the PHQ-2. Each part scores 0 to 6, and 3 or more on either part is a positive screen, to be followed by the GAD-7 or the PHQ-9 and a clinical interview.
instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

licence.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute. Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc.
licence.permission: None needed: the statement printed on the PHQ-4 and on phqscreeners.com, which offers it. It is printed unchanged.

source.name: PHQ-4 (Kroenke, Spitzer, Williams and Löwe), from phqscreeners.com

cutoffs.meaning: positive anxiety screen: give the GAD-7 and a clinical interview
positive depression screen: give the PHQ-9 and a clinical interview

subscales_source.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW, Löwe B. An ultra-brief screening scale for anxiety and depression: the PHQ-4. Psychosomatics. 2009;50(6):613-621; and the PHQ Screeners Instruction Manual (Pfizer).
subscales_source.stated: The Instruction Manual: the PHQ-4's anxiety (GAD-2) and depression (PHQ-2) parts each score 0 to 6, and "the recommended cutpoints for each when used as screeners is a score of 3 or greater"; a score of 3 or greater "should prompt administration of the full PHQ-9 and/or GAD-7, as well as a clinical interview". The total of 0 to 12 is a measure of caseness; the manual gives no bands for it, so none are printed.

questions.2: Pfizer's printed PHQ-4 (phqscreeners.com) asks "Not being able to stop or control worrying"; LOINC 68509-9 writes the time frame into this one item, as in the GAD-7.
